SELECT role.id, role.role_name, role.role_code, role.description, role.is_system, role.status, GROUP_CONCAT( role_permission.permission_id ORDER BY role_permission.permission_id SEPARATOR ',' ) AS permission_ids FROM sys_role role LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role.id WHERE role.deleted = 0
AND role.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY role.id, role.role_name, role.role_code, role.description, role.is_system, role.status, role.create_time ORDER BY role.create_time DESC
